description: This file defines the MessageTimeoutException class, which is a final, immutable exception class used in the Eclipse Ditto project to indicate that a message has exceeded its specified timeout period. It includes mechanisms for constructing instances with various details, serialization/deserialization from JSON, and building via a nested builder class.

classes.name: MessageTimeoutException
classes.description: A final, immutable exception class indicating a message timeout in the Eclipse Ditto framework. Extends DittoRuntimeException and implements MessageException, providing various constructors, serializers, and a builder for creating instances with specific details.
